name: Red Hot Chili Peppers

whyMatters.en: Los Angeles funk-rock four-piece formed in 1983. Blood Sugar Sex Magik (1991) and Californication (1999) put Flea’s slap bass and Frusciante’s clean-to-crunch guitar on alternative radio.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶 funk-rock 四人组，1983 年成立。Blood Sugar Sex Magik（1991）与 Californication（1999）把 Flea 打点贝斯与 Frusciante 干净到 crunch 的吉他送上 alternative 电台。

lyricQuotes: Under the bridge downtown / Is where I drew some blood
Give it away, give it away, give it away now

shortBio.en: Kiedis / Flea / Frusciante funk-alt; Blood Sugar and Californication are the radio peaks.
shortBio.zh: Kiedis / Flea / Frusciante 的 funk-alt；Blood Sugar 与 Californication 是电台高峰。

body.en:
Formed in 1983 in Los Angeles. Mother’s Milk and Blood Sugar Sex Magik (Rick Rubin) fix the hard-funk writing: Flea’s slap bass as lead voice, Frusciante’s chord voicings, Chad Smith’s pocket.

Californication (1999) and By the Way add melodic ballad craft after lineup changes. Give It Away, Under the Bridge, and Californication show funk rhythm and hard-rock distortion in one four-piece, without later rap-metal polish.
body.zh:
1983 年于洛杉矶组建。Mother’s Milk 与 Blood Sugar Sex Magik（Rick Rubin）固定硬 funk 写法：Flea 打点贝斯作主声部、Frusciante 和弦声部、Chad Smith 口袋感。

Californication（1999）与 By the Way 在阵容变动后加入旋律谣曲写法。Give It Away、Under the Bridge、Californication 显示 funk 节奏与 hard-rock 失真可同用四人组，且无后期 rap-metal 抛光。

note.en: Rubin-produced funk-punk peak; Flea slap bass as lead hook on MTV.
note.zh: Rubin 制作的 funk-punk 高峰；Flea 打点贝斯当主 hook 上 MTV。

note.en: Clean arpeggios and falsetto chorus; ballad side on rock radio.
note.zh: 干净琶音与假声副歌；谣曲面进入摇滚电台。

note.en: Frusciante return cycle; melodic riff over dry Rick Rubin mix.
note.zh: Frusciante 回归周期；干声 Rubin 混音上的旋律 riff。

title.zh: Alt-rock 电台上的 funk 贝斯

body.en:
Blood Sugar Sex Magik (1991) puts slap bass and punk-funk rhythm on MTV beside grunge. Rick Rubin’s dry mix keeps drums forward; Frusciante’s clean-to-crunch toggles define the guitar chair.

Californication (1999) shows the same four can carry ballad singles without losing the pocket. On the 1990s map, RHCP are LA funk-hard rock next to Seattle quiet-loud.
body.zh:
Blood Sugar Sex Magik（1991）把打点贝斯与 punk-funk 节奏送上 MTV，与 grunge 并列。Rick Rubin 干混让鼓靠前；Frusciante 干净到 crunch 的切换定义吉他席。

Californication（1999）显示同一四人组也能扛谣曲单曲而不丢口袋感。在 1990 年代地图上，RHCP 是洛杉矶 funk-hard rock，旁靠西雅图强弱动态。

title.en: Frusciante cycles and fixed rhythm section
title.zh: Frusciante 周期与固定节奏组

body.en:
Kiedis and Flea stay from 1983. Frusciante enters in 1988, leaves after Blood Sugar, returns for Californication through By the Way. Chad Smith holds drums from 1988.

Peak citation is the Rubin / Frusciante / Smith quartet. Navarro and later guitarists mark other chapters; catalog memory stays on the Frusciante funk-alt records.
body.zh:
Kiedis 与 Flea 自 1983 年起固定。Frusciante 1988 入队、Blood Sugar 后离队、Californication 至 By the Way 回归。Chad Smith 自 1988 年起守鼓席。

引用峰值是 Rubin / Frusciante / Smith 四人组。Navarro 与后期吉他手是其他章节；目录记忆停在 Frusciante funk-alt 唱片。

title.en: Funk pocket in later alt and stadium rock
title.zh: 后期 alt 与体育场摇滚中的 funk 口袋

body.en:
Foo Fighters and Muse cite the melodic hard-rock side; slap bass as a lead instrument appears on 2000s festival sets. Less Seattle grunge writing than peers—more LA punk-funk and Van Halen–style chord moves.

Influence shows in slap-bass-forward rock radio and in bands that copy Flea’s register without Kiedis’s rap-flow.
body.zh:
Foo Fighters 与 Muse 引用旋律 hard-rock 面；主奏级打点贝斯出现在 2000 年代音乐节。西雅图 grunge 写法少于同辈——更偏 LA punk-funk 与 Van Halen 式和弦。

影响可见于打点贝斯靠前的摇滚电台，以及只抄 Flea 音区、难抄 Kiedis rap-flow 的乐队。

body.en: Rubin-produced funk-punk peak; Flea slap bass as lead hook on MTV.
body.zh: Rubin 制作的 funk-punk 高峰；Flea 打点贝斯当主 hook 上 MTV。

interviewQuotes.text: Frusciante made us a song band again, not just a funk circus.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Anthony Kiedis

interviewQuotes.text: The bass is the melody until the vocal arrives.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Flea

note.en: Frusciante peak guitar; funk verses into melodic choruses.
note.zh: Frusciante 巅峰吉他；funk 主歌进旋律副歌。

note.en: Clean arpeggio ballad; Chili Peppers mainstream radio entry.
note.zh: 干净分解和弦谣曲；Chili Peppers 主流电台入口。

note.en: Funk-punk to alt radio; Frusciante as harmonic center.
note.zh: Funk-punk 进 alt 电台；Frusciante 为和声中心。
